description: Ranked list of Cardano stake pools with ticker, live stake (ADA), saturation (percent), margin (percent), fixed cost (ADA per epoch), pledge (ADA), delegators, blocks this epoch, estimated yearly return at 100 % luck (percent) and, over its recent finished epochs, luck (blocks minted / blocks expected, percent) and the yearly return delegators got. Use it to compare pools or to find one by ticker or name.

limit.description: How many pools to return (1-50, default 10).

maxMarginPct.description: Only pools with a margin of at most this percent.

maxSaturationPct.description: Only pools at most this percent saturated (100 = full).

query.description: Ticker prefix, part of the name, or the start of a pool id.

sort.description: Ordering (margin, fixedCost and ticker ascend; the others descend). luck = recent blocks minted / expected, among pools expected to make at least a block an epoch; rosRecent = recent yearly return of delegators.

name: list_stake_pools
title: Rank stake pools
